# DeadHangs.com: key answers

> One passage per key page, copied from the page itself. Each URL is canonical. Last reviewed 2 November 2026.

## Dead hang time by age: what does your result mean?
URL: https://deadhangs.com/dead-hang-time-by-age/

A useful starting point is a controlled hold you can repeat without pain. No large study has measured dead hang time across the population and there is no verified average. The main measured sample is 25 recreational athletes aged about 20 (GRIP-6, 2025): men held 64.0 seconds and women 48.4 seconds on average with wide variation.

## How to run a dead hang max test
URL: https://deadhangs.com/dead-hang-standards/

Warm up, rest, then hang once until your grip starts to slip. Use the same setup and rest every time, and test no more than once every two weeks.

## Dead Hang: What It Is, How to Do It and How Long to Hold
URL: https://deadhangs.com/deadhang-guide/

A dead hang is a static hold from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended and bodyweight supported entirely by your grip. You grab the bar, step off the ground and hang. No pulling and no swinging.

## How to Dead Hang: Step-by-Step Form Guide
URL: https://deadhangs.com/how-to-deadhang/

To dead hang, grip a pull-up bar overhand at shoulder width, step off with straight arms, set your shoulders and hold while breathing slowly. Stop one or two seconds before your grip gives out and step down under control.

## Dead hang pull-up: starting from a full hang
URL: https://deadhangs.com/dead-hang-pull-up/

A dead hang pull-up is a pull-up that begins from a full hang with straight arms. You pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower back to the same straight-arm hang. If you can't do one, you can still train toward it with hangs, scapular pulls and slow lowering.

## Weighted Dead Hang: How Much Weight to Add and a 4-Week Plan
URL: https://deadhangs.com/weighted-hang-guide/

A weighted dead hang adds external resistance to the standard bodyweight hang. You use a dip belt, a dumbbell held between the feet, a weight vest or a loaded backpack. The extra load asks more of the fingers, forearms and shoulder stabilizers.

## Dead hang world record: the category decides the time
URL: https://deadhangs.com/dead-hang-world-record/

The longest dead hang on the Guinness dead-hang-position page is 80 minutes 41 seconds, held by Kenta Adachi. Two other hanging titles list different times, including the women's record.

## Dead Hangs for Grip Strength: Do They Work and How to Train Them
URL: https://deadhangs.com/grip-strength/

Yes, dead hangs build support grip endurance, the grip that holds a bar, a barbell or a heavy bag. They train crush grip and pinch grip much less. Below: what to do when your grip gives out first, and a training dose.

## Grip strength by age: average kg for men and women
URL: https://deadhangs.com/grip-strength-by-age/

The figures below come from Dodds et al. (PLOS ONE 2014), a pooled analysis of 12 British studies. It covers 60,803 grip measurements from 49,964 participants aged 4 to 90 and over. Of those participants, 26,687 were female. The data are observational. Median grip peaked at 51 kg in males (ages 29 to 39) and 31 kg in females (ages 26 to 42) and then fell with age.
